# TDrive v3.1.4

This release fixes an Android startup crash on x86_64 emulators and devices
(such as MuMu), tidies two mobile screens, and refreshes the README. Bản phát
hành này sửa lỗi ứng dụng Android bị đóng ngay khi mở trên trình giả lập hoặc
thiết bị x86_64 (ví dụ MuMu), sửa hai màn hình trên điện thoại và làm mới
README, kèm bản README tiếng Việt.

## Highlights

- Android: the app starts on x86_64 emulators and devices again. The APK
  packages only the native libraries it can load, so x86_64 emulators run it
  through ARM translation.
- Mobile: the Encryption settings password-hint field no longer overlaps, and
  the Photo and video backup page is centered with the correct bottom padding
  above the tab bar.
- Documentation: refreshed README with an animated logo, a Vietnamese README,
  and organized screenshots.

## Android startup crash fix

- Fixes the "library libwails.so not found" error at startup on x86_64
  emulators and devices (for example MuMu). The release APK previously carried
  x86_64 native libraries from a dependency but no x86_64 `libwails.so`, so
  Android picked x86_64 as the primary ABI and failed to load the app.
- The APK now packages only the ABIs that carry `libwails.so` (arm64-v8a).
  x86_64 emulators run the arm64 build through ARM translation.
- CI and the release workflow now verify the APK ABIs before publishing, so a
  package with an ABI that has no `libwails.so` fails the build.

## Mobile UI

- **Encryption settings**: the password-hint field no longer overlaps other
  content.
- **Photo and video backup**: the page is centered, and its bottom padding
  clears the tab bar.

## Documentation

- The README has an animated logo and a refreshed landing section.
- A Vietnamese README (`README.vi.md`) is available next to the English one.
- Product screenshots are organized under `docs/screens`.

## Internal

- The iOS `Info.plist` and `Info.dev.plist` version fields now match the build
  configuration.

## Downloads

| Platform | File | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Windows 10/11 (64-bit) | `TDrive-v3.1.4-windows-amd64-setup.exe` | Installer. A portable `TDrive-v3.1.4-windows-amd64.zip` is also attached. |
| macOS (Apple silicon) | `TDrive-v3.1.4-macos-arm64.zip` | Unzip and drag TDrive to Applications. |
| Linux (64-bit) | `TDrive-v3.1.4-x86_64.AppImage` | `chmod +x` it, then run it. Needs glibc 2.35 or newer. |
| Android 7.0 or newer (ARM64) | `TDrive-v3.1.4-android-arm64.apk` | Allow installs from your browser or file manager when Android asks. |
| iPhone / iPad (iOS 16 or newer) | `TDrive-v3.1.4-ios-unsigned.ipa` | Not signed. Install with TrollStore, Sideloadly or AltStore. |

## Integrity

- `checksums.txt` lists SHA-256 digests for the downloadable packages.
- `checksums.txt.sig` authenticates that manifest for the desktop updater using the embedded Ed25519 trust keys.
- Android release certificate SHA-256: `A8:F4:4A:72:E0:56:E1:79:DE:19:4C:F3:E3:10:84:9D:5C:B6:BA:5A:58:EC:5F:A6:AD:BA:DD:29:FB:DC:22:92`.
